ops.title: iOS app unreachable off-LAN: pair QR named a LAN IP; July TestFlight Kit rejects newer boards
ops.body:
Oct 4 2026, lane present-mobile-fix.

Root cause of "mobile app not working":
1. Reachability. `cc-present pair` encoded the first LAN IPv4 (http://192.168.4.21:61118). The owner's phone (tailnet node yphone) was off the home LAN: tailscale showed it direct via a public AT&T address (12.199.79.138), while the Mac's public address was 104.1.90.148. The paired URL had no route. Fixed in PR #18 (v0.37.3): pair names the bare MagicDNS label (http://yasyf-forge-studio:61118) when meshtrust detects the mesh and tailscale is up. Bare label because the app's ATS config is only NSAllowsLocalNetworking: unqualified names pass, *.ts.net over http is blocked, and 100.64/10 literals are reported blocked on iOS 17+.
2. Stale client. The last TestFlight build (run 29697685524, 2026-07-19, sha 0dbbb4b) Kit, run against the live 0.37.2 daemon, failed to reduce 1 of 11 boards: `option visual: type "filetree" is not an allowed visual`. The current main Kit reduced all 11. The live-daemon probe harness is a SwiftPM executable that depends on CcPresentKit by path.
3. Updating to a main build requires re-pairing: Keychain service hard-cut to com.yasyf.cc-present.v1 (6156a4e/0aa4fb7 era), so old tokens are invisible and the row shows "Forget and pair this machine again."

Local simulator runs were blocked: Xcode 27 is installed, but its first launch never ran (CoreSimulator 1051.55 < expected 1171.7), so simctl execs `xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch`, which needs admin.
Separate daemon bug: cc-interact v0.35.2 nil-store panic in channel.Connectivity.OnPresenceChange during shutdown. It appears before every restart in ~/.cc-present/daemon.log.
